name: Kaynes Technology

snapshot.about: Kaynes Technology operates in EMS, semiconductor packaging (OSAT), printed circuit board manufacturing, and space technology.

narrative: Management's growth story holds with Q1 FY27 revenue rising 40.6% to ₹946 crore. However, numbers diverge from guidance: FY26 total revenue of ₹3,626 crore missed the ₹4,000 crore minimum target, and FY26 operating cash flow reached −₹600 crore despite profit.

cash.read: Profits do not convert into cash. Cumulative operating cash flow was −₹615 crore over FY22–FY26 against ₹977 crore reported profit, while debtor days surged from 72 to 154.

bull.point: Total revenue reached ₹946 crore in Q1 FY27, representing 40.6% YoY growth driven by standalone EMS growth of 53%.

evidence.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting an year-on-year growth of 40%
Our total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting an year-on-year growth of 40%, which is largely driven by EMS business
So as a stand-alone EMS business if you see, our growth is 53%, from INR480 crores of last year to this year of INR639 crores stand-alone EMS business

bull.point: Order book reached around ₹9,000 crore as of Q1 FY27, offering strong medium-term execution visibility.

evidence.quote: We have a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores

bull.point: Government subsidy of ₹170 crore was received for the OSAT business till July 2026 to support semiconductor capex expansion.

evidence.quote: We also received, happy to say that we also received the government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26

bear.point: Debtor days expanded from 72 to 154 between FY24 and FY26, contributing to negative cumulative free cash flow of ₹3,288 crore over five years.
